name: back-of-the-head-lying-tricep-extension.html
instructions:
1. Sit on the end of a flat bench with a barbell on your thighs.
2. Grip the barbell with an overhand (palms facing down) with your hands about shoulder width apart.
3. Bring the bar up to your chest and lay down on your back.
4. Extend your arms straight up above your chest.
5. Keeping your arms straight, move the bar back to the position shown in the video above.
6. Keeping your elbows fixed in place and not pointing out, slowly lower the bar until it is almost touching the top of your head or bench behind your head.
7. Pause, and then slowly extend your arms back to the starting position.
8. Do not lock your elbows out, and then repeat for desired reps.
